name: Each duration lives with its owner
summary: The timing package is gone. Each package and app keeps its durations in its own constants file, beside the code that reads them, and exports a group only when another package reads it. A relation between durations of two owners is checked by an import or a test.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk#9jix9Dsx
changes.value: The entrance, the departure, the far swap and the flight into a card follow the same rule. Nothing here draws, reads a clock or keeps state between frames, so the same inputs give the same items. The durations come from the page that hosts the painter. flight.rs holds what moves a whole picture: a flight from the last picture, a part-by-part entrance, a leaving picture, the ghost of one that left, and the model inside a card that the camera flies into.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/vKEsyHFk#lU0khwR0
changes.value: Its npm build bundles codex-app-server, process and diagnostics, which are MIT like it; every other workspace package is BUSL and stays out of it. Archboard and the example reach it only through the entries an outside host uses.
